payload.reason: The evidence discusses various stopping methods and their performance in active learning tasks, specifically focusing on the impact of batch sizes and window sizes on stopping decisions.

claims.text: The Oracle Method is evaluated as a benchmark for stopping methods in active learning.
The BV2009 stopping method is evaluated, which uses kappa agreement values to determine when to stop the active learning process.
Different batch sizes (1%, 5%, and 10% of training data) are evaluated to assess their impact on stopping methods.
The performance degradation of stopping methods with larger batch sizes is evaluated.
